name: tool-naomi197-invoice-sanity-check-qhj8bq39
description: Check invoice line amounts, subtotal, tax, and total using exact Decimal arithmetic. The result of check_invoice is the only pass or fail.
author: fazeli1977-dot

tools.name: check_invoice
tools.description: Deterministically check invoice line amounts (quantity x unit price), the subtotal, an optional tax rate and the total. Returns valid=true/false and a list of issues.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: Line items. Each item is an object with quantity, unit_price, amount and an optional description.

parameters.name: subtotal
parameters.description: Stated subtotal. Omit to skip the stated-subtotal check.

parameters.name: tax_rate
parameters.description: Optional tax rate in percent (e.g. 10 for 10%).

parameters.name: tax
parameters.description: Stated tax amount. Defaults to 0 when no tax_rate is given.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional currency code, e.g. USD. Echoed in the result.
